# simplevm Provider

The SimpleVM provider manages virtual machines, volumes and snapshots in the de.NBI Cloud via the SimpleVM REST API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) SimpleVM API key, sent as the `X-API-KEY` header. May also be set with the `SIMPLEVM_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the SimpleVM portal API. Defaults to `https://simplevm.denbi.de/portal/api/`. May also be set with the `SIMPLEVM_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `project_id` (Number) Default SimpleVM project ID used by resources that do not set their own `project_id`. May also be set with the `SIMPLEVM_PROJECT_ID` environment variable.
